tools.name: get_signup_schema
tools.description: Returns the authoritative JSON schema, required fields and privacy terms for the waitlist transaction (exactly what GET /api/signup returns). Read this before joining.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: One typed transaction: joins the named person to the Clair pilot waitlist. consent: true is a recorded claim - assert it only with the person's consent. One submission per person; repeats return already: true. Returns an edit_token binding follow-up details. Identify yourself with agent_name, agent_

tools.name: update_waitlist
tools.description: Merges follow-up details into an existing waitlist record. Requires the edit_token returned by join_waitlist - email alone never authorizes a merge.
